about.title: The Story Behind the Bakes
about.subtitle: Meet Yevheniia, founder and cake designer
about.p1: Born on October 19, 1993, in Ukraine, I discovered my passion for baking and fine pastry art at a young age. The magic of transforming simple ingredients into beautiful, delicious creations has been my lifelong companion.
about.p2: Today, I live in the beautiful city of Bern, Switzerland. Here, I combine my Ukrainian roots and traditional recipes with modern Swiss precision and the finest local ingredients. Every cake that leaves my studio is custom-tailored to delight your eyes and palate.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common inquiries about orders, deliveries, and ingredients
faq.q1: How far in advance should I place my order?
faq.a1: For wedding cakes, we recommend booking 2 to 3 months in advance. For standard celebration cakes or bento cakes, please request at least 7 to 10 days before your event.
faq.a2: Yes, we deliver wedding and large celebration cakes in Bern and the surrounding area. Smaller orders can be picked up directly from our atelier in Bern.
faq.q3: Do you offer gluten-free or lactose-free cakes?
faq.a3: Yes, many of our flavor recipes can be adapted to be lactose-free or gluten-free. Please specify any food allergies when submitting your inquiry.
faq.a4: To reserve your date, we require a 50% deposit after aligning on cake specifications. The remaining balance is payable via Twint or bank transfer before delivery.
